caption_L1: Number of visitors to the Crowdcube website between 2011 and 2012 is a bar chart. Along the x-axis, Number of visitors is measured with a linear scale of range 0 to 140,000. There is a categorical scale with Australia on one end and United States at the other along the y-axis, labeled Country.
caption_L2L3: Traffic data is given for 10 countries, and for 9 of those the traffic is below 20,000 visitors. The countries with fewer than 20,000 visitors are Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, and United States. Visitors from the United Kingdom were the most numerous at above 120,000 visitors. The second most visitors came from the United States with approximately 10,000 recorded.
